headline: A 2018 law renamed a New York waterway, the Negro Bar Channel, as the Joseph Sanford Jr. Channel.
what_it_does: This law changes the official name of a waterway in New York State from the Negro Bar Channel to the Joseph Sanford Jr. Channel. It does not appear to change how the channel is built, used, funded, or regulated. The law was signed on October 9, 2018.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on October 9, 2018.
